A Tense First Half Early exchanges saw both teams engaging in a physical battle, with tactical discipline taking precedence over creative flair. While Telstar earned numerous corner kicks, Jeff Hardeveld was unable to connect with his teammates in the box. The Heracles defense held firm, and despite a few attempts to break the deadlock, the sides entered the interval with the scoreline untouched, reflecting a cagey and methodical approach from both managers. Breaking the Deadlock The second half proved to be a completely different spectacle, as the game opened up and quality in the final third began to shine through. Guus Offerhaus provided the spark in the 70th minute, burying a right-footed shot to give the hosts the lead. The floodgates opened quickly thereafter: Tyrese Noslin doubled the advantage just two minutes later following a clever assist from Patrick Brouwer . Before the visitors could recover, Jeff Hardeveld rose to head home a third goal in the 77th minute, delighting the 5,142 fans in attendance. Late Drama The closing stages were marred by frustration for the visitors. As Heracles searched for a consolation goal, the match turned sour in stoppage time. Following a VAR review, Luka Kulenovic was shown a straight red card in the 92nd minute for a reckless challenge on Nils Rossen , effectively ending any hopes of a late comeback and cementing the 3-0 scoreline.
